My mother has no idea how to actually run a business

Open thread • Replies: 16 • Updated: 2026-08-08 18:37 UTC

OP

My mom rented out a room earlier this year to start a spa and has so far not had a single paying customer months later, costing her $240 a week in rent. But instead of actually trying to grow her business, she's done a bunch of stupid crap instead.
>Set up an expensive website with GoDaddy where 90% of the content is AI generated, from the imagery to the fake reviews. No pictures of her or the spa on it.
>Has yet to set up an Instagram account to advertise because she "doesn't know how," and whenever I try to do it for her she says "we'll do it later"
>Wastes hundreds of dollars on fancy business cards instead of something basic and fucking notepads with her company logo (AI generated) on it
>Refuses to go out and make friends that she could advertise her business to. I always tell her to go to the huge ass Catholic church in the wealthy part of town for mass or to join a women's group but she comes up with some bullshit about she "doesn't understand the mass times"
>When she comes home or has time off, instead of figuring out how to grow her business, she just pisses away the hours by obsessively cleaning the house, cooking elaborate time-wasting meals, watching Housewives on her tablet, or going out grocery shopping for lentils or some bullshit we don't even need
What really drove me nuts was that I set her up on a little coffee meet-up with a friend who does real estate and was offering to advertise her business to clients absolutely free of charge. What does she do? She just doesn't show up. Doesn't text the guy or anything. Called her this morning to ask how it went and she told me she just didn't go because she was "busy" despite setting the date up a fucking week in advance.
I'm at my goddamn wits' end with this woman. She treats her spa like a fucking Barbie dream house instead of an actual damn business and then BLAMES ME of all fucking people. Never listens to my damn advice even though I have a degree in economics.
